messages:
maria: Heads-up: the ZephyrXL model card has a broken anchor in the catalog and an old SDK snippet under 'long-context tips'. catalog links to /models/zephyrxl#limits but the card uses '## Sequence limits' so anchor is #sequence-limits.
aj: is the bad URL in the catalog index or embedded elsewhere?
maria: catalog index. also snippet uses RedwoodClient.generate (v1). we should update to responses.create (v2).
sam: can draft a tiny PR to fix both. paste replacement snippet?
maria: old:
```python3
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient()
resp = client.generate("Summarize: ...", max_tokens=512)
print(resp.text)
```
new suggestion:
```python3
from redwood import Client
import os
client = Client(api_key=os.environ['REDWOOD_API_KEY'])
resp = client.responses.create(model="zephyr-xl", input="Summarize: ...", max_output_tokens=512)
print(resp.output[0].content)  # use raw response element
```
leo: also add an anchor shim so legacy links keep working. our renderer accepts `{#id}` so add `### Limits {#limits}`.
jen: confirmed, mkdocs supports that. I'll add it in the PR.
sam: opened draft PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4620 with catalog link fix, anchor, and snippet swap. CI running.
docbot: PR opened by sam: #4620  CI checks running.
leo: lint flagged codeblock label and line length. sam: will fix.
sam: addressed lint, preview: https://deploy-preview-4620--docs.redwood.ai/models/zephyrxl
jen: QA: ensure snippet matches actual SDK response shape. SDK helper `output_text` exists but using `resp.output[0].content` is clearer. add a changelog frontmatter line about snippet migration.
aj: also add a short note about quantized variants having reduced effective context (one sentence).
maria: added quant note: 'Note: Quantized 8-bit variants may exhibit reduced effective context; for stable long-sequence workloads prefer full-precision variants or our recommended chunking strategy.' Pushed.
docbot: PR merged by sam  https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4620  CI passed, deployed to staging.
jen: can we add a redirect for external links hitting the old anchor?
leo: follow-up PR added redirect mapping /models/zephyrxl#limits -> /models/zephyrxl#sequence-limits (PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4621).
maria: added ticket on docs-ship board to update SDK migration guide example mappings. @aj will draft the migration blurb.
aj: will draft migration note and include sample generate -> responses mappings. thanks!
